sloka: अद्य इमाम् भक्षयिष्यामि पश्यतः तव मानुषीम् ।त्वया सह चरिष्यामि निःसपत्ना यथा सुखम् ॥३-१८-१६॥
transliteration: adya imām bhakṣayiṣyāmi paśyataḥ tava mānuṣīm ।tvayā saha cariṣyāmi niḥsapatnā yathā sukham ॥3-18-16॥

translations.english: I shall eat up this woman now before your very eyes and I can move about happily with you without a cowife.
